title: KingSett Proposes Redesigned 46-Storey Towers at 7 Labatt
summary: Following its placement under receivership, an infill redevelopment site at 7 Labatt Avenue just east of Toronto's Regent Park neighbourhood has returned with a new developer and design team. KingSett Capital is proposing two 46-storey condominium towers designed by Giannone Petricone Associates. Revised from an earlier 44- and 48-storey concept, the proposal would also deliver a replacement building for the Salvation Army at ground level.
